The incumbent followed this but incurred overhead by checking two empty handtowelholders before finding the target in a cabinet. It is unclear if a direct check of cabinets or a different open-surface order would have been faster, as the memory's guidance assumes open surfaces are more likely, which was false here.

Resolving whether to prioritize cabinets or specific open surfaces for cloths changes future search efficiency.
